LanguageData.SettlementServices.Error.RimPactsCivilWa: This faction is in a civil war.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.RimPactsMark: Scales how much RimPacts' enabled global economy (boom/recession) adjusts service prices. 100% follows RimPacts' own economy setting as-is; 0% keeps RimPacts political availability integration on but removes the price effect. Has no effect unless RimPacts is installed and its own market prices setting is enabled.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Settings.RimPactsTrus: Award RimPacts trust for completed services

When a paid service completes successfully, grant a small RimPacts trust gain (+1, before RimPacts' own trust settings) to the faction that accepted the contract. Only applies if RimPacts is installed; RimPacts itself has the final say over whether the gain is applied.
The minimum time between trust rewards for the same faction, shared across every service that faction completes for you.
